title: Arbitrary internal profinite module resolutions compute abelian derived evaluation
statement: Let R be any commutative monoid in abelian sheaves on the coherent site of u-small profinite sets, with coefficients in universe u+1. For any internal R-module M, any injective resolution I of M [def-sp-injective-resolutions], any profinite V, and any positive natural degree q, the homology in degree q of the complex obtained by forgetting the R-action and evaluating I on V is isomorphic to the q-th right derived abelian evaluation of M.X. Use the internal/sectionwise equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. No assumption that forgetting preserves injectives is made.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), second displayed equality, and its proof; internal-to-sectionwise resolution transport supplied by lem-sfb-profinite-free-hom-resolution-evaluation.

proof.text: Transport the arbitrary given resolution by the internal-to-sectionwise equivalence. An equivalence of abelian categories is exact and preserves injectives. Its sections and maps agree with the original underlying abelian sheaf, so its section complex agrees with the complex in the conclusion.

Apply the ringed-site module/abelian evaluation comparison to the transported resolution. To use its common-universe small-site interface, lift the hom sets to u+1 and transfer the topology, sheaves and resolutions along the canonical site equivalence. Derived evaluation is invariant under that exact equivalence. Compose the resulting comparison with the identity of the underlying section complex. The comparison applies to every positive degree and every resolution, and does not assert injectivity of the underlying abelian sheaves.

theorem nonempty_internalModule_eval_homology_iso
    (R : CommMon (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) R.X)
    (I : InjectiveResolution M) (V : Profinite.{u}) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    Nonempty
      (((((Mod.forget R.X ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
          (evaluation Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).homology q) ≅
        (((sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
          (evaluation Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).rightDerived q).obj
            M.X))
